# SideFX

> > SideFX is the creator of Houdini, the industry-leading 3D procedural software for VFX, animation, games, and motion graphics, featuring Karma renderer, Solaris USD workflows, and Houdini Engine integration.

SideFX develops Houdini FX, Houdini Core, and Houdini Indie editions for procedural content creation across film, television, games, and visualization industries. The platform integrates with Unity, Maya, and Unreal Engine through Houdini Engine, and features native USD support through Solaris and the Karma XPU renderer.

## Key Topics

- Houdini procedural workflows
- Karma renderer (CPU/XPU)
- Solaris USD pipeline
- Houdini Engine plugin system
- VEX scripting language
- Pyro FX simulation
- PDG (procedural dependency graphs)
- MaterialX shader workflows
- Houdini Indie licensing
- Maya and Unity integration
- Visual effects production
- Game development tools
- Certified training programs
- Procedural digital assets
- Unreal Engine 5 workflows
